camel_example: aliyun ccc CreateSkillGroup --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId '9cfad875-6260-4a53-ab6e-b13e3fb31f7d' --Name '售前技能组'
description_en: Creates a skill group by calling CreateSkillGroup
kebab_example: aliyun ccc create-skill-group --instance-id 9cfad875-6260-4a53-ab6e-b13e3fb31f7d --name '售前技能组' --api-version 2017-07-05 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSkillGroup

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the call center instance to which the skill group to be created belongs
parameters.help_zh: 待创建的技能组所归属的呼叫中心实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the skill group to be created
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The description of the skill group to be created
parameters.help_zh: 待创建的技能组的描述
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The matching mode. Valid values: default (default mode), acquaintance (acquaintance mode)
parameters.help_zh: 匹配方式。取值：default（默认模式）、acquaintance（熟人模式）
parameters.name: routing_strategy

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to allow the use of personal outbound numbers
parameters.help_zh: 是否允许使用个人外呼号码
parameters.name: allow_private_outbound_number

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the outbound number to be associated with the skill group.


OutboundPhoneNumberId.1 indicates that only one outbound number is associated. To associate multiple numbers, specify multiple parameters such as OutboundPhoneNumberId.1, OutboundPhoneNumberId.2, and OutboundPhoneNumberId.3
parameters.help_zh:
需要绑定到技能组的外呼号码的号码ID。


参数名称为OutboundPhoneNumberId.1意为只绑定一个外呼号码，如果绑定多个号码，则需要传多个，例如 OutboundPhoneNumberId.1、OutboundPhoneNumberId.2、OutboundPhoneNumberId.3，以此类推
parameters.name: outbound_phone_number_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the agent to be added to the skill group.

UserId.1 indicates that only one agent is associated. To associate multiple agents, specify multiple parameters such as UserId.1, UserId.2, and UserId.3. Note that UserId refers to the unique identifier of the RAM user within the call center instance, not the RamId of the RAM user
parameters.help_zh:
需要加入到技能组中的坐席ID。

UserId.1意为只绑定一个坐席，如果绑定多个，则需要传多个，例如 UserId.1、UserId.2、UserId.3，以此类推。注意UserId指RAM子账号在呼叫中心实例的唯一标识UserId，并非RAM子账号的RamId
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en:
The skill level. Indicates the level of the agent in the skill group. The value ranges from 1 to 10. Incoming calls are preferentially assigned to agents with higher levels.

SkillLevel.1 sets the skill group level for the corresponding UserId.1. If multiple UserIds are specified, the same number of SkillLevel parameters must be specified
parameters.help_zh:
技能级别。表示该坐席在技能组的等级，等级区间为1-10，来电后优先分配给等级高的坐席。

SkillLevel.1代表为上面的UserId.1设置技能组等级，如果userId为多个，则SkillLevel也需要多个，并且数量需要保持一致
parameters.name: skill_level

SkillGroupId.description_en: The ID of the newly created skill group

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
